context: Gantt chart with edge-bundled dependency chains across 4 project phases (~50 tasks), with hover-activated upstream/downstream chain highlighting
first_impression: Structurally honest Gantt with data-driven time scale, correct band scale for categorical tasks, and proper key-function data joins.
what_works: xScale domain is derived from d3.min/d3.max of actual data (not hardcoded), and .data(taskData, d => d.id) key function is present on bar join ensuring correct object constancy under reorder.
what_doesnt: Math.max(4, xScale(d.end) - xScale(d.start)) inflates very short task durations visually — a minor lie factor for near-zero-width bars; subset robustness is weak since removing the earliest-start or latest-end task would shift the xScale domain and reposition all remaining bars.
